## AdaptiveCurveIrm #2

Inverts the re-clamp guard, so a fresh market is priced at config time and a live one keeps a stale band.

- **Mutant:** [`2.sol`](2.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`stAciFreshConfigNeverPricesMarket`](../../specs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/AdaptiveCurveIrm_properties.spec#L37) · [`stAciConfigRenewalReclampsRateIntoNewBand`](../../specs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/AdaptiveCurveIrm_properties.spec#L50)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh AdaptiveCurveIrm 2`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/properties.conf --rule stAciFreshConfigNeverPricesMarket stAciConfigRenewalReclampsRateIntoNewBand`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/AdaptiveCurveIrm.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/AdaptiveCurveIrm.sol
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@
         // The saved rate must obey the new band immediately — adaptation alone would re-clamp it late or never.
         // 0 means the market was never priced: the first call seeds it, so it must stay 0.
         int256 storedRate = rateAtTarget[id];
-        if (storedRate != 0) {
+        if (storedRate == 0) {
             rateAtTarget[id] = storedRate.bound(curveParams.minRateAtTarget, curveParams.maxRateAtTarget);
         }

```

```diff
@@ -112,7 +112,7 @@
```

- **Mutant:** [`20.sol`](20.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`utAciBorrowRateTouchesOnlyTargetMarket`](../../specs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/AdaptiveCurveIrm_properties.spec#L290)

```diff

+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/AdaptiveCurveIrm.sol
@@ -101,6 +101,7 @@
         (uint256 avgRate, int256 endRateAtTarget) = _borrowRate(id, market);

         rateAtTarget[id] = endRateAtTarget;
```
